description: The rebuild orders the playlist store writes for the Queue's build job. An order is written the moment a school's policy or a checklist's playlist is found stale (its pages or its catalog page differ from what is read now), when a stored playlist fails the current save check, and, when a school's policy passes its save and replaces the one in use, for every playlist built on the replaced policy. At most one order is open or taken per policy or playlist, and an order that ended done or dropped is not written again for the same row and reason. action list (the default) answers the orders, the oldest first, with an optional status (open, taken, done or dropped) and limit (default 50, at most 500). action take, with order_id, makes one open order taken; a playlist order waits, answered taken false with the reason, while its school's policy order is open or taken. action finish, with order_id and ending (done or dropped), ends a taken order, with the optional request_id that ran it and a note of what the build said. action release, with order_id and note, turns a taken order whose build was lost back to open, keeping the note in result_note; it is not ended, so it counts as neither done nor dropped. The row in use keeps serving until a rebuild passes its save and replaces it.

action.description: list (the default), take, finish or release

ending.description: With finish: done when the rebuild passed, dropped when it failed

limit.description: Optional, with list: how many orders to answer (default 50, at most 500)

note.description: Optional with finish: what the build said. Required with release: why the order goes back to open

order_id.description: With take, finish or release: the order

request_id.description: Optional, with finish: the build request that ran the order

status.description: Optional, with list: only the orders with this status

name: playlist_rebuild_orders
title: Playlist Rebuild Orders
